title: Banks and the Magic of Finance

topics.title: Financial infrastructure and what banks do
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; What are banks and what do they do?

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what financial infrastructure is and how it supports physical infrastructure.
Describe how a bank links savers who deposit money with borrowers who need loans.

topics.title: Holding deposits: types of bank accounts and the passbook
topics.ncert_sections: Hold deposits; Types of bank accounts (Fig. 8.4); Passbook

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between savings, current and fixed deposit accounts.
Interpret debit and credit entries recorded in a bank passbook.

topics.title: Interest and the magic of compounding
topics.ncert_sections: Interest on deposits; The Magic of Compounding - the story of a King and a Sage

concepts.learning_objective: Define interest as the cost of borrowing or the gain from lending money.
Calculate how a deposit grows when interest is earned on earlier interest.
Use the king and sage chessboard story to explain exponential growth.

topics.title: Loans, how banks earn, and the Jan Dhan Yojana
topics.ncert_sections: Offer loans or credit; Don't miss out; Jan Dhan Yojana

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the purposes for which people and businesses take bank loans.
Explain how the gap between deposit and loan interest rates gives banks income.
Describe how the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana widened access to banking.

topics.title: Other financial institutions and the Reserve Bank of India
topics.ncert_sections: Other Financial Institutions; Reserve Bank of India - Banker to Banks; Temples as lenders

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the financial roles of post offices, NABARD and the Industrial Finance Corporation of India.
State the functions of the RBI as India's central bank and banker to banks.
Compare the lending role of temples in ancient India with modern banks.

topics.title: Payment modes and systems
topics.ncert_sections: Payment Modes and Systems; Cheque; Debit cards and POS; Internet banking; Mobile payments; UPI

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how cash is withdrawn using a withdrawal slip or a debit card at an ATM.
Compare cheques with electronic payment methods such as POS machines and internet banking.
Explain the steps of a UPI transaction and why UPI became popular.
Explain what a share is and why companies issue shares on a stock exchange.
Analyse the factors that cause share prices to rise and fall, leading to booms and crashes.

topics.title: Financial frauds and the role of financial infrastructure
topics.ncert_sections: Financial frauds and how to prevent them; Before we move on

concepts.learning_objective: Apply safety practices to avoid and report digital payment frauds.
Evaluate how financial infrastructure contributes to a nation's progress.
